note: FAILURE spec: what a stopped D1 behavioural session still owes. Nothing is `required`, deliberately -- an early failure may legitimately have produced none of it, and demanding an artifact on the failure path would block the collection of what the run DOES have. The driver writes `d1_behavioural.json` on every path out, and every probe that FINISHED has its result, per-sample rows and generations announced already -- the launcher's poll hook pulls them off-pod while the next probe trains, so the failure path collects the stragglers rather than carrying the whole burden.
patterns_are_relative_to: the collector's --root, which SessionRunner sets to <checkout>/artifacts. See the success spec.
